lines.zh: 我迈着两条腿走过林地
lines.en: I stride through the grove on two legs.
My feathers darken in the light.
I step over soft fallen leaves.
I walk and scan around.
I round the roots.
I stop at the lake to drink.
I push out of the shrubs.

lines.zh: 爪子扣着地面，羽毛立起来。
lines.en: Claws gripping soil, feathers bristling.
I look up at the canopy.
I pace along the shore.
One step clears the little ditch.
I lower my neck.
Slow, but I do not stray.
I tuck behind the trunk.
I skirt my neighbour's ground.
I head deeper into the woods.
I stand still by the lake.
I groom the feathers on my chest.
Head tilted, listening to the wind.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨了一下
lines.en: I rake the ground once.
I watch my reflection.
I draw my neck in.
I blink my small eyes.
I am watching for anyone near.
I lift one foot.
I bask in the woodland light.
I shake my feathers up.
I stand with not a feather stirring.
I sweep a look over my ground.
A low call comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 义县组的绒毛，还留在我身上。
lines.en: Yixian fuzz still clings to me.
You have walked into my ground.
My feathers stand up.
I stretch my neck straight.
I take a step toward you.
What is that you are holding?
I stand before the nest behind me.
I do not back off.
You had better step back.
I open my beak and show teeth.
The pain makes me spring aside.
I retreat behind a tree.
Down feathers scatter as I back off.
I growl and turn.
My claws can't hold my weight.
I brace myself.
That one landed solid.
I draw my neck back in.
I shake my feathers and recover.
I do not mean to leave just yet.
Are you eating something?
That smell drifts over.
I tilt my head at your hand.
I come one step closer.
I am not quite sure.
I back off again.
I dip my head to sniff.
I do not know this thing.
I raise my long neck again.
I wait for you to set it down.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我侧身顶回去
lines.en: You hit me; I shove back with my flank.
My feathers are crushed out of place.
I step back and hold.
I edge past your side.
I stamp once.
I shove you aside.
We knock together dully.
I lower my head and eye you.
I return to my spot.
No shoving here.
She comes along the shore.
We groom each other's feathers.
She is a little shorter than I.
We lower our heads to drink together.
She leans her neck against mine.
We circle the lake together.
She walks half a step ahead.
She calls low and I answer.
We walk into the tree shade together.
She rests her head against my neck.
I peck it up.
I shake it and set it down.
I push it aside with a claw.
I pin the bark down with a hind claw.
I peck at it once.
I toss it away.
I peck it back up.
I hide it under leaves.
I look around once.
I carry it in my beak and set it by the nest.
My feet nail down.
I stretch my neck out.
I open my beak and growl low.
I stand before the nest.
My feathers all stand up.
I raise one big foot.
I take a step toward you.
This ground is mine.
I spread my claws in front of the nest.
I will give you one chance to go.
Move again and I charge.
I lower myself, ready.
I track your movement.
I will not let you round my back.
My neck stays pointed at you.
I wait for you to step back.
My claws scrape the ground.
You go left; I shift left.
I do not call, only stare.
The nest behind me stays untouched.

lines.zh: 我算着你冲过来的距离
lines.en: I measure the distance you would charge.
I shift my weight forward.
Come one step closer and see.
I am not easy to push back.
I dig my claws in deeper.
I slash with a claw.
I bite at its leg.
I shoulder it away.

lines.zh: 我的爪子撕开了它的皮
lines.en: My claws tear its hide.
It backs off; I follow one step.
I fling it aside with my head.
I plant a foot on it.
I growl and retreat.
Its blood spatters my feathers.
I stand before the nest again.
That one was only a warning.
It runs; I do not chase far.

lines.zh: 我的爪子能剥下整条树皮。
lines.en: My claws peel a whole strip of bark.
My feathers show first.
I stop by the lake.
First I look over this ground.
I shake the leaves off me.
I come to stand on this ground.
I raise my head to listen.
This wood is thick.
I walk slowly across the clearing.
My shadow drags over the leaves.
Neck stretched, I reach the tender branch.
I look down at my feet.
This grove will do.
I begin patrolling my ground.
Fire singes my feathers.
I slide down the slope.
Soaked feathers; I can't swim.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连同落叶掀翻
lines.en: The blast flips me over with the leaf litter.
Something lodges in my body.
Spell light curls my feathers.
Hunger makes my feathers droop.
Lightning splits the tree behind me.
The forest floor is gone.
